147:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Battles between $$スフィア$$s will surely generate plenty of $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

147:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once we've gathered them, the real battle will begin... for us, for $n, and for them.」

147:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, Bushi... I mean, $$グラハム$$.」

147:t_10:15.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'll be counting on you again, $$ＡＧ$$.」

147:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you've joined $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ in North America too, Bushi... I mean, $$グラハム$$.」

147:t_10:17.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Jokes like that no longer trouble me.」

147:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all your doubts, you've found your answer. I hope you never lose your way again.」

147:t_10:19.en:
$$グラハム$$
「So you know about my past.」

147:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know... Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeblood.」

147:t_10:22.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The shame of my past was necessary to make me who I am today. I won't deny it.」

147:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then may I freely ask how you felt back then?」

147:t_10:24.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, you want to hear old stories?」

147:t_10:26.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's not what you should call me.」

147:t_10:28.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Nope! It's Happy $$コーラサワー$$ now! Update your information!」

147:t_10:30.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll tell you my memories with Colonel $$マネキン$$... I mean, Brigadier General $$マネキン$$.」

147:t_10:31.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Chapter One, Episode One: Our first meeting, and that shocking slap!」

147:t_10:33.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Information is your lifeblood, isn't it? Then gather it properly.」

147:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But who will mind the $$Ｄトレーダー$$...?」

147:t_10:35.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Leave it to me! Today, I'll do business with gusto!」

147:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ミレイナ$$, where did you come from?!」

147:t_10:37.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Wherever people talk of love, $$ミレイナ・ヴァスティ$$ will be there!」

147:t_10:38.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is approaching. Keep it brief, Lieutenant $$マネキン$$.」

147:t_10:39.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Sure! I'll only go up to Chapter Thirteen today!」

147:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It's no use... I can't beat this man...)

148:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All units are in position.」

148:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「General $$藤堂$$ is commanding the defensive line. We'll stand by in $$トウキョウ$$ for emergencies.」

148:t_000:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Calm down, $n. You can't draw out the $$ジェニオン$$'s power like this.」

148:t_000:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I know you're on edge about facing a $$リアクター$$.」

148:t_000:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If your mind is off balance, your body won't move freely. Remember that.」

148:t_000:10.en:
$n
「Captain $$アムロ$$, why did you team up with me?」

148:t_000:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This isn't the time to talk, but you're nervous, so I'll tell you. I partly teamed up with you to get a feel for the $$ジェニオン$$ up close.」

148:t_000:12.en:
$n
「You wanted to get a feel for the $$ジェニオン$$...?」

148:t_000:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe it's because my father was an engineer, but I've liked machines since I was a child.」

148:t_000:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps that's why I don't get overly sentimental about them.」

148:t_000:15.en:
$n
「So you don't get sentimental about machines?」

148:t_000:16.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That goes for my own machine too.」

148:t_000:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「My childhood aside, as a soldier, I saw the $$ガンダム$$ as a useful tool. I felt no special attachment to it.」

148:t_000:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's how I used to think, anyway.」

148:t_000:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I still think mobile suits and other machines are tools.」

148:t_000:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「One theory says that ancient humans evolved by learning to use tools and fire.」

148:t_000:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Perhaps humanity is going through another such transition now.」

148:t_000:24.en:
$n
「You mean tools and machines will make humans evolve?」

148:t_000:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$Ｚガンダム$$ and $$ユニコーン$$ turn will into power. The $$ダブルオーライザー$$'s $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ promotes awakening as an $$イノベイター$$...」

148:t_000:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And then there's the $$ジェニオン$$. Seeing these machines makes me wonder.」

148:t_000:27.en:
$n
「The $$ジェニオン$$ will make me evolve...」

148:t_000:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wanted to get a feel for the $$ジェニオン$$ up close. Sorry, but indulge my curiosity.」

148:t_000:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Thank you, Captain $$アムロ$$. $n has calmed down...)

148:t_000:32.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy has breached the first defensive line! They'll enter $$トウキョウ$$ soon!」

148:t_000:33.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

148:t_001:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「There's a whole army of them!」

148:t_001:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「General $$藤堂$$'s defensive line should have reduced their numbers, but...」

148:t_001:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It shows how serious the enemy is.」

148:t_001:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We must win this battle to break the deadlock.」

148:t_001:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... Everyone's full of spirit.」

148:t_001:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that the enemy commander...?」

148:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's a superior's duty to clean up an incompetent subordinate's mess.」

148:t_001:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Tch... That $$サルディアス$$... He just had to get a jab in...)

148:t_001:10.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Allow me to introduce myself. I'm $$サルディアス・アクス$$, age forty-two.」

148:t_001:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm commanding the invasion of $$トウキョウ$$. Remember my name, even if it's only for today.」

148:t_001:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This man directed the operation to hurt the people of $$新日本$$...?」

148:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Not quite right, but not wrong either. I'm the one who carried it out.」

148:t_001:14.en:
$$カレン$$
「Quit joking! Because of you, $$新日本$$...!」

148:t_001:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「People misunderstand me because of how I talk. I'm always serious, working hard and taking the initiative.」

AG again deliberately cuts off the old nickname and corrects it to Graham.
AG's startled call to Colasour is a complete name-only exclamation.
AG responds with Colasour's requested epithet, a deliberate name-only correction.
Colasour announces his story's chapter and episode title; the deliberate title fragment retains its form.
AG calls Graham's name for help as a deliberate interrupted address.
Hibiki is silent; the source contains only an ellipsis.
Suzune's concerned name-only address is deliberately retained.
Hibiki begins an objection with But and stops before stating it.
Suzune begins a contrasting thought with But and trails off without stating it.
Quatre's statement deliberately ends with but, leaving the contrast implicit in the visible enemy numbers.
Kallen deliberately breaks off before stating what the enemy did to New Japan.
